summary: US forces struck two IRGC missile launchers on Iran's Lark Island that were preparing to fire naval mines toward the Strait of Hormuz. Israel eliminated two Hamas Nukhba operatives in Khan Yunis and a Hamas military operative in Gaza, while thwarting a seven-pistol smuggling attempt at the Jordan border. Israeli naval intelligence reports heightened Turkish Navy readiness in the Mediterranean, and a Mossad regime-change project involving Kurdish fighters was revealed.

sections.executive_summary: US forces struck two IRGC missile launchers on Iran's Lark Island that were preparing to fire naval mines toward the Strait of Hormuz, marking a direct American military action against Iranian assets. Israel conducted targeted killings of three Hamas operatives in Gaza — two Nukhba commanders in Khan Yunis and a military wing member — while simultaneously foiling a weapons smuggling attempt of seven pistols at the Jordan Valley border. Israeli naval intelligence reports a significant increase in Turkish Navy exercises and presence in the Mediterranean, assessed as preparation for a potential military confrontation, while a major Mossad regime-change operation against Iran involving Kurdish fighters was revealed to have been blocked by the US during the last Iran-Israel war.

points: US forces struck two Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps missile launchers on Lark Island in Hormozgan Province, which were preparing to launch missiles armed with naval mines toward the Strait of Hormuz, according to a US official speaking to Al Jazeera. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387664, @shin_persian/9210)

Mossad's 'Project Garden,' a global influence operation launched after October 7 to overthrow the Iranian regime, involved training thousands of Kurdish fighters in Israel for operational scenarios; the plan was presented three days into the last Iran-Israel war but blocked by a US message not to execute, and an alternative plan failed to achieve desired results. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387649)

TankerTrackers reports Iranian oil exports are currently near zero, with only 3.8 million barrels per day transiting the Strait of Hormuz last week — all from other Gulf states — compared to 9.8 million bpd during the previous MOU period. (Source: @asafroz/52891)
US Senator Ted Cruz publicly advocated sending weapons to Iranian protesters and arming Kurds to overthrow the regime, explicitly ruling out American boots on the ground. (Source: @kianmeli1/91229)

Iranian domestic commentary acknowledges sanctions have 'broken the back' of the Islamic Republic and warn of famine risk, while state-aligned channels mock official celebrations and claim 'we won the war' despite economic collapse. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79960, @mamlekate/104271, @mamlekate/104273)

Kataib Hezbollah's cultural mobilization council issued a statement for Islamic Unity Week emphasizing dialogue over sectarianism, framing unity as a cultural and intellectual project to counter media disinformation and digital hatred. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387648)

Senior US military leaders warned Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth that prolonging large-scale offensives against Iran is unsustainable and actively degrades America's ability to confront threats elsewhere, including homeland defense. (Source: @presstv/204762)

IDF eliminated two Hamas Nukhba operatives — Yasser Abu al-Khair and Muhammad al-Adin — in Khan Yunis, southern Gaza, accusing them of promoting terror plots against Israeli forces and civilians, rebuilding Hamas capabilities, and systematically violating the ceasefire. (Source: @yediotnews25/134440)

IDF struck and killed Hassam Asama Hussein Nazir, a Hamas military wing operative who advanced terror plans against IDF troops and Israeli civilians, in an operation to remove the threat. (Source: @almogboker78/18084)

Israeli security forces — including the Jordan Valley Brigade, Magav Yehuda, and Jordan Border Unit — thwarted a weapons smuggling attempt at the eastern border, seizing seven pistols after a suspect armed with a knife was shot and fled; the weapons were intended for transfer into Israeli territory. (Source: @inon_yttach/9977)

Israeli Navy intelligence has identified increasing Turkish Navy readiness over recent months, including more military exercises and greater presence in the Mediterranean and Israeli naval sailing areas, assessed as a 'potential transformation' requiring operational and strategic preparedness for a military confrontation scenario. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387649, @New_security8200/203494)

Mossad's 'Project Garden' regime-change operation against Iran, run from outside Mossad headquarters by a known campaign director, triggered an exceptional internal investigation; the project trained thousands of Kurdish fighters in Israel but was halted by US intervention during the last Iran war. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387649)

sections.threat_assessment: The US strike on IRGC naval mine launchers at Lark Island signals a willingness to directly target Iranian strategic assets threatening Hormuz shipping lanes, raising the risk of Iranian retaliation against Gulf energy infrastructure or US forces. Israel's simultaneous targeting of Hamas leadership in Gaza and interdiction of West Bank weapons smuggling indicates a sustained campaign to degrade militant capabilities despite ceasefire frameworks. The revealed Mossad regime-change project and Turkish naval buildup suggest a multi-axis pressure campaign on Iran, but US military warnings about readiness degradation imply strategic limits to escalation. Turkish-Israeli maritime tensions add a NATO-complication layer, while Qatar's Lebanese diplomacy and UAE-Egypt banking coordination reflect Gulf efforts to manage fallout.
sections.regional_response: Qatar's Emir engaged Lebanon's president to support diplomatic stabilization, while UAE and Egypt coordinated banking compliance under US sanctions pressure. Gulf oil flows through Hormuz remain robust despite Iranian export collapse, indicating successful market replacement. Kataib Hezbollah's unity messaging attempts to frame the 'Resistance Axis' as intellectually cohesive amid setbacks. Turkish naval posturing in the Mediterranean challenges Israeli maritime dominance and may signal Ankara's readiness to contest energy zones or support Hamas supply routes. The US-Iran direct clash at Lark Island, combined with Israeli kinetic actions in Gaza and the West Bank, creates a synchronized pressure environment that could provoke asymmetric responses from Iranian proxies in Iraq, Syria, or Yemen.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Lark Island strike demonstrates precise US intelligence on IRGC naval mine deployment timelines, likely from persistent ISR over the Strait. Mossad's 'Project Garden' details — including Kurdish fighter training in Israel — reveal a deep, long-term regime-change infrastructure that was operationalized post-October 7 but remains vulnerable to US political veto. Turkish naval exercises in Israeli sailing areas suggest intelligence collection on Israeli naval patterns and potential rehearsal for interdiction scenarios. The seven-pistol seizure at the Jordan border indicates active small-arms smuggling networks persisting despite Jordanian-Israeli security cooperation. Hamas Nukhba targeting in Khan Yunis shows Israeli intelligence penetration of Hamas's rebuilt command structure in southern Gaza. US military readiness warnings reflect genuine concern over force posture sustainability across CENTCOM and INDOPACOM theaters.
